overall_summary: Analysis of the performance data reveals a clear outperformance of husband-wife relationship themes ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar...' with 1,766 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात...' with 1,674 views) compared to generalized heartbreak or family member specific tributes. Content grounded in realistic relationship dynamics and everyday married life friction resonates significantly better with the audience.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on married life dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात...') received 1,600+ views, vastly outperforming generic poetry or other family tributes.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dilemmas, unspoken expectations, and emotional distance in marriage.

weak_patterns.pattern: Overly poetic or dramatic shayari hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos with heavily dramatic phrasing like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained minimal traction (17 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract poetic grievances; anchor content in tangible, observable everyday moments.
